name: How long does it take to install built-in shelving?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install built-in shelving?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for built-in shelving depends on the project's scope, design complexity, and the number of units. A smaller, straightforward shelving unit might take a few days from start to finish, including custom fabrication and on-site fitting. Larger, more intricate projects involving multiple rooms or unique features will naturally require more time. During our initial consultation, we provide a projected timeline after understanding your specific requirements and surveying the installation site.
